bank_content.forbidden: reusing any PR G/H/I/J family or mechanism; family-specific seeds chosen by hand; any input other than the derived seeds
bank_content.grammar: steps drawn from {quote, alert, revision, goal, score}; 4 to 8 steps; at least one relation between non-adjacent steps; at least one of price, volume, count or score transitions; nuisance (distractors, near-omnipresent decoys, unrelated background fixtures, scale shifts, delays) drawn from the seeds

beacon.availability: a round is unavailable only if, within 7 days after its time, fewer than relay_quorum relays return identical randomness and signature with randomness == sha256(signature); then the next round of the sequence applies
beacon.derivation: seed = first 8 bytes of HMAC-SHA256(key=randomness, msg="goal-roi-k0/v1/<protocol sha256>/<slot>/<role>/<i>") mod 2^63
beacon.forbidden: choosing another round, relay subset or derivation for any other reason
beacon.network: drand quicknet (League of Entropy), unchained BLS on G1
beacon.selection: the first round of primary + k*fallback_step whose scheduled time is at least minimum_margin after the latest of: B commitment publication, K lock publication (GitHub server timestamps)
beacon.verification: before the K lock, D fetches /info for this chain hash from at least two relays and checks chain hash, genesis and period; any mismatch requires a protocol amendment with a new primary round at least 30 days after the amendment

commitments.B: generator tree commitment, file count, and nothing else
commitments.C: K lock: commit SHA of the algorithm and its parameters, published in the repository

commitments.publication: as a comment on the K0 tracking pull request; the GitHub server timestamp is the publication time; the repository commit carrying the same value is secondary
